matrix_name.name: Polyamide-6
matrix_name.description: PA-6 particles with an average size of 50 um.

fillers.name: Few-layer graphene
fillers.description: Exfoliated from graphite powder, resulting in FLG with an average of ~7-8 layers, an average thickness of ~2.6 nm, and an average lateral size of ~0.5 um. Produced by mechanochemistry with supercritical CO2.
